source_text: Please, have a seat.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.Please, have a seat.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.Please, have a seat."

translation: Proszę, usiądź.

source_text: All finished, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.All finished, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.All finished, Lillian."

translation: Wszystko gotowe, Lillian.

source_text: How did it taste?

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.How did it taste?
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.How did it taste?"

translation: Jak smakowało?

source_text: You’re not the woman I expected you to be, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You’re not the woman I expected you to be, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You’re not the woman I expected you to be, Lillian."

translation: Nie jesteś kobietą, jakiej się spodziewałem, Lillian.

source_text: A welcome surprise, I hope.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.A welcome surprise, I hope.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.A welcome surprise, I hope."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że to miłe zaskoczenie.

source_text: We best get dressed. Dinner will be served shortly.

structure.raw_value: LiFlEx.We best get dressed. Dinner will be served shortly.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlEx.We best get dressed. Dinner will be served shortly."

translation: Lepiej się ubierzmy. Kolacja zostanie podana wkrótce.

source_text: Is the meal to your liking, Madam?

structure.raw_value: HoFrOp>.Is the meal to your liking, Madam?
structure.script_literal: "HoFrOp>.Is the meal to your liking, Madam?"

translation: Czy posiłek pani odpowiada, madam?

source_text: A job well done. The Lord has blessed you with many talents.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.A job well done. The Lord has blessed you with many talents.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.A job well done. The Lord has blessed you with many talents."

translation: Dobra robota. Pan obdarzył cię wieloma talentami.

source_text: I do my best to serve the wishes of the Lord.

structure.raw_value: HoFrEx>.I do my best to serve the wishes of the Lord.
structure.script_literal: "HoFrEx>.I do my best to serve the wishes of the Lord."

translation: Robię, co w mojej mocy, by służyć woli Pana.

source_text: Go now. And pray.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.Go now. And pray.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.Go now. And pray."

translation: Idź teraz. I módl się.

source_text: Yes, Madam.

structure.raw_value: HoFrOp>.Yes, Madam.
structure.script_literal: "HoFrOp>.Yes, Madam."

translation: Tak, madam.

source_text: I’ve worked up quite an appetite.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’ve worked up quite an appetite.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’ve worked up quite an appetite. "

translation: Zrobiłem się dość głodna.

source_text: Enjoy the meal, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: LiFlEx.Enjoy the meal, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlEx.Enjoy the meal, 1Hero."

translation: Smacznego, 1Hero.

source_text: I’ve already had a pretty tasty snack, myself.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.I’ve already had a pretty tasty snack, myself.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.I’ve already had a pretty tasty snack, myself."

translation: Ja już miałam całkiem smaczną przekąskę.

source_text: The first of many shared moments, I hope.

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.The first of many shared moments, I hope.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.The first of many shared moments, I hope."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że to pierwszy z wielu wspólnych momentów.

source_text: An excellent meal, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: ErFrOp.An excellent meal, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrOp.An excellent meal, Lillian."

translation: Doskonały posiłek, Lillian.

source_text: I’m glad you enjoyed your meal.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.I’m glad you enjoyed your meal.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.I’m glad you enjoyed your meal."

translation: Cieszę się, że smakował ci posiłek.

source_text: If you’ll excuse me, I must tend to my work.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.If you’ll excuse me, I must tend to my work.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.If you’ll excuse me, I must tend to my work."

translation: Jeśli pozwolisz, muszę zająć się pracą.

source_text: Thanks for inviting us over, Lillian. It’s been an unexpectedly good time.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.Thanks for inviting us over, Lillian. It’s been an unexpectedly good time.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.Thanks for inviting us over, Lillian. It’s been an unexpectedly good time."

translation: Dziękujemy za zaproszenie, Lillian. To był nieoczekiwanie miły czas.

source_text: I look forward to the next time we can enjoy each other's company.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.I look forward to the next time we can enjoy each other's company.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.I look forward to the next time we can enjoy each other's company."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać następnego razu, gdy będziemy mogli cieszyć się swoim towarzystwem.

source_text: Goodbye, 1Hero. Do you know the way out?

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.Goodbye, 1Hero. Do you know the way out?
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.Goodbye, 1Hero. Do you know the way out?"

translation: Żegnaj, 1Hero. Wiesz, jak wyjść?

source_text: I’ll show him.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx.I’ll show him.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx.I’ll show him."

translation: Odprowadzę go.

source_text: That was crazy!

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.That was crazy!
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.That was crazy!"

translation: To było szalone!

source_text: Not a bad plan, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.Not a bad plan, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.Not a bad plan, 1Hero."

translation: Niezły plan, 1Hero.

source_text: To earn her trust… I think she trusts us.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.To earn her trust… I think she trusts us.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.To earn her trust… I think she trusts us."

translation: By zdobyć jej zaufanie… Myślę, że nam ufa.

source_text: Yeah. I think that’s safe to say.

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.Yeah. I think that’s safe to say.
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.Yeah. I think that’s safe to say."

translation: Tak. Można tak powiedzieć.

source_text: It didn’t look like you had to try too hard.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.It didn’t look like you had to try too hard.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.It didn’t look like you had to try too hard."

translation: Nie wyglądało na to, że musiałaś się bardzo starać.

source_text: I’ve never had a threesome before.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.I’ve never had a threesome before.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.I’ve never had a threesome before."

translation: Nigdy wcześniej nie miałem trójkąta.

source_text: I’ll admit that was fun.

structure.raw_value: ErFlOp.I’ll admit that was fun.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlOp.I’ll admit that was fun."

translation: Przyznam, że to była zabawa.

source_text: What do you think of Lillian? Do you think she’s hiding something?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What do you think of Lillian? Do you think she’s hiding something?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What do you think of Lillian? Do you think she’s hiding something?"

translation: Co myślisz o Lillian? Myślisz, że coś ukrywa?

source_text: If she is, we’ll find it.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.If she is, we’ll find it.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.If she is, we’ll find it."

translation: Jeśli tak, znajdziemy to.

source_text: What if she’s just a lonely girl we’re spying on?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.What if she’s just a lonely girl we’re spying on?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.What if she’s just a lonely girl we’re spying on?"

translation: A co jeśli to tylko samotna dziewczyna, którą śledzimy?

source_text: You’re a detective. Snooping around is your job.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.You’re a detective. Snooping around is your job.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.You’re a detective. Snooping around is your job."

translation: Jesteś detektywem. Węszenie to twoja praca.

source_text: It seems we have some time alone. Maybe we can find something while we’re here.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It seems we have some time alone. Maybe we can find something while we’re here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It seems we have some time alone. Maybe we can find something while we’re here."

translation: Wygląda na to, że mamy chwilę sami. Może znajdziemy coś, skoro tu jesteśmy.

source_text: Let’s split up and search the mansion.

structure.raw_value: ErHaOp.Let’s split up and search the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaOp.Let’s split up and search the mansion."

translation: Rozdzielmy się i przeszukajmy rezydencję.

source_text: Just be careful, Erica.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Just be careful, Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Just be careful, Erica."

translation: Tylko uważaj, Eriko.

source_text: I know this place well. I won’t get into trouble.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.I know this place well. I won’t get into trouble.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.I know this place well. I won’t get into trouble."

translation: Znam to miejsce dobrze. Nie wpadnę w kłopoty.

source_text: Lillian didn’t seem to mind that I was late. But we shouldn't make a habit out of staying up late.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.Lillian didn’t seem to mind that I was late. But we shouldn't make a habit out of staying up late.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.Lillian didn’t seem to mind that I was late. But we shouldn't make a habit out of staying up late."

translation: Lillian nie wydawała się przejmować moim spóźnieniem. Ale nie powinniśmy przyzwyczajać się do zarywania nocy.

source_text: Act cool, 1Hero. Someone’s in the kitchen and I don’t know if you’re really allowed to be here right now.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.Act cool, 1Hero. Someone’s in the kitchen and I don’t know if you’re really allowed to be here right now.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.Act cool, 1Hero. Someone’s in the kitchen and I don’t know if you’re really allowed to be here right now."

translation: Zachowuj się naturalnie, 1Hero. Ktoś jest w kuchni i nie wiem, czy naprawdę wolno ci tu teraz przebywać.

source_text: Wait, who’s in the kitchen?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Wait, who’s in the kitchen?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Wait, who’s in the kitchen?"

translation: Zaraz, kto jest w kuchni?

source_text: Just… come on.

structure.raw_value: ErAnOp.Just… come on.
structure.script_literal: "ErAnOp.Just… come on."

translation: Po prostu… chodź.

source_text: Go find some honey and give it to the leper in the kitchen…

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.Go find some honey and give it to the leper in the kitchen…
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.Go find some honey and give it to the leper in the kitchen…"

translation: Idź znajdź miód i daj go trędowatemu w kuchni…

source_text: We need to get him to leave.

structure.raw_value: ErBaDe.We need to get him to leave.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaDe.We need to get him to leave."

translation: Musimy sprawić, by wyszedł.

source_text: Get him some honey and when he leaves we can check it out…

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.Get him some honey and when he leaves we can check it out…
structure.script_literal: "ErBaEx.Get him some honey and when he leaves we can check it out…"

translation: Zanieś mu miód, a gdy wyjdzie, sprawdzimy to…

source_text: But don’t go back in there without the honey. He’s getting suspicious.

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.But don’t go back in there without the honey. He’s getting suspicious.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.But don’t go back in there without the honey. He’s getting suspicious."

translation: Ale nie wracaj tam bez miodu. Zaczyna być podejrzliwy.

source_text: Erica, 1Hero. A surprise to see you here.

structure.raw_value: LiFlDe.Erica, 1Hero. A surprise to see you here.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlDe.Erica, 1Hero. A surprise to see you here."

translation: Eriko, 1Hero. Co za niespodzianka.

source_text: I was just finishing up.

structure.raw_value: ErFrCl^.I was just finishing up.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrCl^.I was just finishing up."

translation: Właśnie kończyłam.

source_text: She… had a hard time reaching something.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She… had a hard time reaching something.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She… had a hard time reaching something."

translation: Ona… miała problem, by coś dosięgnąć.

source_text: Such a helpful detective.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Such a helpful detective.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Such a helpful detective."

translation: Taki pomocny detektyw.

source_text: Well… I should get going.

structure.raw_value: ErFrCl^.Well… I should get going.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrCl^.Well… I should get going."

translation: Cóż… Powinnam już iść.

source_text: Enjoy your weekend, Erica.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Enjoy your weekend, Erica.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Enjoy your weekend, Erica."

translation: Miłego weekendu, Eriko.

source_text: Thank you, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: ErHaOp^.Thank you, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaOp^.Thank you, Lillian."

translation: Dziękuję, Lillian.

source_text: 1Hero, stay behind. I want to speak with you.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.1Hero, stay behind. I want to speak with you.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.1Hero, stay behind. I want to speak with you."

translation: 1Hero, zostań. Chcę z tobą porozmawiać.

source_text: Uhh, okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Uhh, okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Uhh, okay."

translation: Yyy, jasne.

source_text: See you at seven o'clock, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx^.See you at seven o'clock, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx^.See you at seven o'clock, 1Hero."

translation: Do zobaczenia o siódmej, 1Hero.

source_text: Playing games without me?

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.Playing games without me?
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.Playing games without me?"

translation: Bawicie się beze mnie?

source_text: Huh? No… We were just… I was helping her out.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Huh? No… We were just… I was helping her out.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Huh? No… We were just… I was helping her out."

translation: Co? Nie… My tylko… Pomagałem jej.

source_text: I hope I can trust that you’ll respect my wishes in the future.

structure.raw_value: LiFlOp.I hope I can trust that you’ll respect my wishes in the future.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlOp.I hope I can trust that you’ll respect my wishes in the future."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że mogę liczyć, iż uszanujesz moje życzenia w przyszłości.

source_text: Of course. I’m sorry, Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Of course. I’m sorry, Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Of course. I’m sorry, Lillian."

translation: Oczywiście. Przepraszam, Lillian.

source_text: I would very much enjoy joining you next time you and Erica have an itch for a bit of excitement.

structure.raw_value: LiFlEx.I would very much enjoy joining you next time you and Erica have an itch for a bit of excitement.
structure.script_literal: "LiFlEx.I would very much enjoy joining you next time you and Erica have an itch for a bit of excitement."

translation: Bardzo chętnie dołączę następnym razem, gdy ty i Erica poczujecie ochotę na odrobinę ekscytacji.

source_text: Haha. I’m sure she’d love that.

structure.raw_value: McHaOpNo4.Haha. I’m sure she’d love that.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOpNo4.Haha. I’m sure she’d love that."

translation: Haha. Jestem pewien, że bardzo by chciała.

source_text: It is getting late. If you don’t mind, I'd like to be alone.

structure.raw_value: LiFrEx.It is getting late. If you don’t mind, I'd like to be alone.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrEx.It is getting late. If you don’t mind, I'd like to be alone."

translation: Robi się późno. Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, chciałabym zostać sama.

source_text: Yes, Lillian. I should get going.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Yes, Lillian. I should get going.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Yes, Lillian. I should get going."

translation: Tak, Lillian. Powinnam już iść.

source_text: Did I fool her, or is she fooling me?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Did I fool her, or is she fooling me?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Did I fool her, or is she fooling me?"

translation: Czy ją oszukałem, czy to ona oszukuje mnie?

source_text: I need to figure out what’s going on under the kitchen…

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.I need to figure out what’s going on under the kitchen…
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.I need to figure out what’s going on under the kitchen…"

translation: Muszę dowiedzieć się, co dzieje się pod kuchnią…

source_text: But it’ll have to wait.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But it’ll have to wait.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But it’ll have to wait."

translation: Ale to musi poczekać.

source_text: Hey, you two. I need some help… unlocking this door.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.Hey, you two. I need some help… unlocking this door.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.Hey, you two. I need some help… unlocking this door."

translation: Hej, wy dwoje. Potrzebuję pomocy… z otwarciem tych drzwi.

source_text: It is not our place to enter that room. If you need help, find Lillian.

structure.raw_value: HoAnDe>.It is not our place to enter that room. If you need help, find Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnDe>.It is not our place to enter that room. If you need help, find Lillian."

translation: Nie powinniśmy wchodzić do tego pokoju. Jeśli potrzebujesz pomocy, znajdź Lillian.

source_text: It’s stuck. I just need a strong man to open it.

structure.raw_value: ErFlEx.It’s stuck. I just need a strong man to open it.
structure.script_literal: "ErFlEx.It’s stuck. I just need a strong man to open it."

translation: Zacięły się. Potrzebuję tylko silnego mężczyzny, by je otworzyć.

source_text: The door is locked. You need a key.

structure.raw_value: HoAnEx>.The door is locked. You need a key.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnEx>.The door is locked. You need a key."

translation: Drzwi są zamknięte. Potrzebujesz klucza.

source_text: Well… Shit.

structure.raw_value: ErAnOp.Well… Shit.
structure.script_literal: "ErAnOp.Well… Shit."

translation: Cóż… Cholera.

source_text: Hey! No flowers. Mother does not like you changing the decorations.

structure.raw_value: HoAnOp>.Hey! No flowers. Mother does not like you changing the decorations.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnOp>.Hey! No flowers. Mother does not like you changing the decorations."

translation: Hej! Żadnych kwiatów. Matka nie lubi, gdy zmieniasz dekoracje.

source_text: But it’s just so beautiful. I just want to see how it would look.

structure.raw_value: ErHaEx.But it’s just so beautiful. I just want to see how it would look.
structure.script_literal: "ErHaEx.But it’s just so beautiful. I just want to see how it would look."

translation: Ale to takie piękne. Chcę tylko zobaczyć, jak by to wyglądało.

source_text: Now’s my chance.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Now’s my chance.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Now’s my chance."

translation: Teraz moja szansa.

source_text: Alright. I’m in.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Alright. I’m in.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Alright. I’m in."

translation: Dobra. Wszedłem.

source_text: Could I pry it open with something?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Could I pry it open with something?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Could I pry it open with something?"

translation: Czy mogłbym to podważyć czymś?

source_text: There's an opening in the wall.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.There's an opening in the wall.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.There's an opening in the wall."

translation: W ścianie jest otwór.

source_text: Maybe if I put this eyeball in the socket…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Maybe if I put this eyeball in the socket…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Maybe if I put this eyeball in the socket…"

translation: Może jeśli włożę to oko do oczodołu…

source_text: I heard something!

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.I heard something!
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.I heard something!"

translation: Coś słyszałem!

source_text: Bobby… We’re running out of time.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Bobby… We’re running out of time.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Bobby… We’re running out of time."

translation: Bobby… Kończy nam się czas.

source_text: Lilith, a demon from Hell, came through that portal and she has to be stopped.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Lilith, a demon from Hell, came through that portal and she has to be stopped.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Lilith, a demon from Hell, came through that portal and she has to be stopped."

translation: Lilith, demon z Piekła, przeszła przez ten portal i trzeba ją powstrzymać.

source_text: With what? Magic?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.With what? Magic?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.With what? Magic?"

translation: Czym? Magią?

source_text: Of course that’s what you would say.

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.Of course that’s what you would say.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.Of course that’s what you would say."

translation: Oczywiście, że tak powiesz.

source_text: Bobby, they are in this mansion… I think.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Bobby, they are in this mansion… I think.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Bobby, they are in this mansion… I think."

translation: Bobby, oni są w tej rezydencji… Tak myślę.

source_text: This mansion is a big place… Do you know what they look like?

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.This mansion is a big place… Do you know what they look like?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.This mansion is a big place… Do you know what they look like?"

translation: Ta rezydencja jest ogromna… Wiesz, jak wyglądają?

source_text: Let me and my team search the mansion. I know we can find them.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Let me and my team search the mansion. I know we can find them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Let me and my team search the mansion. I know we can find them."

translation: Pozwól mi i mojemu zespołowi przeszukać rezydencję. Wiem, że ich znajdziemy.

source_text: Let’s say we find these amulets. What the hell then?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Let’s say we find these amulets. What the hell then?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Let’s say we find these amulets. What the hell then?"

translation: Załóżmy, że znajdziemy te amulety. Co wtedy, do diabła?

source_text: The priest will help us… He’ll figure out how to stop Lilith.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The priest will help us… He’ll figure out how to stop Lilith.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.The priest will help us… He’ll figure out how to stop Lilith."

translation: Ksiądz nam pomoże… Wymyśli, jak powstrzymać Lilith.

source_text: This sounds crazy… But I know what I saw.

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.This sounds crazy… But I know what I saw.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.This sounds crazy… But I know what I saw."

translation: To brzmi szalenie… Ale wiem, co widziałem.

source_text: It’s not a trick, Bobby. We need to stop her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s not a trick, Bobby. We need to stop her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s not a trick, Bobby. We need to stop her."

translation: To nie jest sztuczka, Bobby. Musimy ją powstrzymać.

source_text: Fine… I’ll let you search the mansion, but my men will be keeping an eye on you.

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx.Fine… I’ll let you search the mansion, but my men will be keeping an eye on you.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx.Fine… I’ll let you search the mansion, but my men will be keeping an eye on you."

translation: Dobrze… Pozwolę wam przeszukać rezydencję, ale moi ludzie będą mieć na was oko.

source_text: Erica’s uniform?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Erica’s uniform?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Erica’s uniform?"

translation: Mundur Eriki?

source_text: She looks so sexy.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.She looks so sexy.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.She looks so sexy."

translation: Wygląda tak seksownie.

source_text: I can bring Sister Judy and Kimberly back to the church…

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx^.I can bring Sister Judy and Kimberly back to the church…
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx^.I can bring Sister Judy and Kimberly back to the church…"

translation: Mogę zabrać siostrę Judy i Kimberly z powrotem do kościoła…

source_text: The father will need to know what’s happening.

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp^.The father will need to know what’s happening.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp^.The father will need to know what’s happening."

translation: Ojciec musi wiedzieć, co się dzieje.

source_text: We must also find a relic.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx^.We must also find a relic.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx^.We must also find a relic."

translation: Musimy też znaleźć relikwię.

source_text: I can help you find one… What do they look like?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.I can help you find one… What do they look like?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.I can help you find one… What do they look like?"

translation: Mogę pomóc wam jedną znaleźć… Jak wyglądają?

source_text: It depends… I’m not familiar with relics at Eve Cathedral.

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe^.It depends… I’m not familiar with relics at Eve Cathedral.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe^.It depends… I’m not familiar with relics at Eve Cathedral."

translation: To zależy… Nie znam relikwii z katedry Ewy.

source_text: I am also not sure what we might have, but Father may be able to point us in the right direction.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx^.I am also not sure what we might have, but Father may be able to point us in the right direction.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx^.I am also not sure what we might have, but Father may be able to point us in the right direction."

translation: Też nie jestem pewna, co możemy mieć, ale ojciec może wskazać właściwy kierunek.

source_text: Sister Judy… Do you have any idea where the amulets are?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Sister Judy… Do you have any idea where the amulets are?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Sister Judy… Do you have any idea where the amulets are?"

translation: Siostro Judy… Masz pojęcie, gdzie są amulety?

source_text: There is more than one?

structure.raw_value: KiWoOp.There is more than one?
structure.script_literal: "KiWoOp.There is more than one?"

translation: Jest ich więcej niż jeden?

source_text: We gave it to someone… They took it to another room.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx^.We gave it to someone… They took it to another room.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx^.We gave it to someone… They took it to another room."

translation: Oddaliśmy go komuś… Zanieśli go do innego pokoju.

source_text: In the mansion?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.In the mansion?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.In the mansion?"

translation: W rezydencji?

source_text: I have no idea where they put it. But that’s where I would look.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I have no idea where they put it. But that’s where I would look.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I have no idea where they put it. But that’s where I would look."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, gdzie go położyli. Ale tam bym szukała.

source_text: We’ll find them.

structure.raw_value: NeFrOp.We’ll find them.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrOp.We’ll find them."

translation: Znajdziemy je.

source_text: Let’s go back to the church.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx^.Let’s go back to the church.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx^.Let’s go back to the church."

translation: Wróćmy do kościoła.

source_text: Father must be so worried.

structure.raw_value: JuSaOp^.Father must be so worried.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaOp^.Father must be so worried."

translation: Ojciec musi być taki zmartwiony.

source_text: So, where do we look for these amulets?

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.So, where do we look for these amulets?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.So, where do we look for these amulets?"

translation: Więc gdzie szukamy tych amuletów?

source_text: They could be anywhere. Let’s spread out.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.They could be anywhere. Let’s spread out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.They could be anywhere. Let’s spread out."

translation: Mogą być wszędzie. Rozdzielmy się.

source_text: I know this place pretty well. I’ll see what I can find.

structure.raw_value: NeFrEx.I know this place pretty well. I’ll see what I can find.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrEx.I know this place pretty well. I’ll see what I can find."

translation: Znam to miejsce całkiem dobrze. Zobaczę, co znajdę.

source_text: I know it’s late, but Melissa is going to want to know what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I know it’s late, but Melissa is going to want to know what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I know it’s late, but Melissa is going to want to know what’s going on."

translation: Wiem, że jest późno, ale Melissa będzie chciała wiedzieć, co się dzieje.

source_text: Melissa… Bobby is here at the mansion… We’re all going to search for the amulets.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Melissa… Bobby is here at the mansion… We’re all going to search for the amulets.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Melissa… Bobby is here at the mansion… We’re all going to search for the amulets."

translation: Melissa… Bobby jest tu w rezydencji… Wszyscy będziemy szukać amuletów.

source_text: What time is it?

structure.raw_value: MeWoOp.What time is it?
structure.script_literal: "MeWoOp.What time is it?"

translation: Która godzina?

source_text: Lillian is going to post the Toma on the internet… We have to stop her now.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Lillian is going to post the Toma on the internet… We have to stop her now.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Lillian is going to post the Toma on the internet… We have to stop her now."

translation: Lillian zamierza wystawić Tomę do internetu… Musimy ją teraz powstrzymać.

source_text: I’ll head over soon.

structure.raw_value: MeWoOp.I’ll head over soon.
structure.script_literal: "MeWoOp.I’ll head over soon."

translation: Wkrótce tam będę.

source_text: This place is huge… How are we supposed to find anything?

structure.raw_value: ObAnDe.This place is huge… How are we supposed to find anything?
structure.script_literal: "ObAnDe.This place is huge… How are we supposed to find anything?"

translation: To miejsce jest ogromne… Jak mamy cokolwiek znaleźć?
